_about: Public-domain John Henry Newman (1801-1890; Anglican, then Roman Catholic, cardinal 1879) for the Word Hoard: The Dream of Gerontius clean from CCEL; the Apologia (1890 printing), the Essay on the Development of Christian Doctrine, the Grammar of Assent, the Idea of a University and Historical Sketches vol. 1 from Project Gutenberg; and the Parochial and Plain Sermons (London: Longmans, Green, 1891, 8 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
